Product Review:

Member 1 - OMG! The first pull from a glass pipe made my hand and feet sweat. It was like an adrenaline rush through my whole body. It's earthy, spicy and a minty after taste. It has a very sharp taste and smell. It looks amazing as of frosted tress. It gives a instant head high. Alien Mints is really strong and hits almost immediately. This strain won't be recommended for first time smokers as it could give paranoia. Alien Mints kept me out of sleep so much that I overslept and felt like I had a weed hangover the next day. Member 2 - This strains smokes very smooth with scratch on the throat. Apple and fresh mint aroma when grinding. Hybrid effects, focused and relaxed feeling simultaneously. Dry mouth and red eyes after a while in about 30mins. Potency Rate 8/10.

Amnesia Haze was developed through collaboration between Soma Seeds and First Medical Seeds, with each using different parent plants. Soma Seeds employed Afghani Hawaiian, Jamaican Sativa, and Laos Sativa, while First Medical Seeds used Super Silver Haze and Cambodia Sativa. There have also been talks about potentially incorporating Thai, Afghani, and Haze strains in the crossbreeding process.

Product Review

User 1: 

  • OMG, it made me super high.
  • Extremely fast head high, euphoria as well as red eyes
  • Creative feel and focused.

products.title: Brainstorm
products.body_html:
Sativa

This Haze strain, which is predominantly sativa, comes from the Netherlands and has a sativa/indica ratio of about 90:10, offering a highly cerebral experience. Created in Amsterdam by Delta 9 Labs, Brainstorm Haze is a cross between Stargazer and a traditional landrace strain from Thailand

Product Review:

Reviewer (Mars): So far my favourite new sativa stain as an indica smoker. Its sweet, citrusy aroma and deep purple, sticky buds!
Despite a slight cough upon smoking, the effects are decidedly positive. I felt clear-headed, focused, and energize and could study after. I had no anxiety. A single bong hit provides a great, clear high, suggesting a potent and enjoyable sativa experience. 10/10

Reviewer (Abu): Spicy and Pineapple Aroma
Smooth smoke minimum cough, heavy scratch on the throat.
Mellow head high in a about 20 minutes after the first puff. Gave me a talkative effect Overall potency 7/10.

Reviewer (Kim): The feeling really goes with the name because of the uplifting, focused feel the strain gives. It's definitely a sativa because the first pull made my whole body sweat. It's an interesting sativa because it didn't give me any paranoia or anxiety. It's a very strong smoke so it's not recommended for first time smokers, the reason for saying that is because it's an almost instant head high. It taste very spicy with a gas and citrus after taste. The bud itself looks and smells amazing with a very pungent terp smell. it's frosted but is sexy to a real stoner. It's sugar, frosted look and it's moist feel is just unbelievable.

products.title: Chinese Medicine Consultation
products.body_html:
Chinese medicine diagnosis is a holistic approach to understanding and treating illness. It is based on the belief that the body is a complex system of interconnected parts, and that disease is caused by imbalances in this system.
Dr Sorger uses a variety of methods to diagnose disease, including:
  • Inspection: This involves looking at the patient's overall appearance, including their complexion, skin condition, and posture.
  • Auscultation and olfaction: This involves listening to the patient's breathing and smelling their body odor.
  • Inquiry: This involves asking the patient about their symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle.
  • Palpation: This involves feeling the patient's pulse and tongue.
The information gathered from these methods is used to develop a diagnosis of the patient's condition. This diagnosis is based on the patient's unique set of symptoms and signs, and will take into account their overall health and well-being.
Many people find that Chinese medicine can be an effective way to treat a wide range of conditions, both acute and chronic.
